issues.description: The continuous-time proof uses the matrix exponential and an integral, while this entry does not explicitly state its scalar field or class of inputs. M016 explicitly allowed an arbitrary field, so a reader could incorrectly carry that scope forward.
issues.fix: State V and Y are finite-dimensional real or complex vector spaces and inputs are piecewise continuous (or otherwise locally integrable); finite-field realizations should be formulated in discrete time instead.

assessments.padic: Fixed-point integrality, unit/nonunit distinction and Hensel digits are correct.
assessments.octonions: Complete homogeneous-coefficient polarization is sufficient; 36 a-values and 64 basis b,c pairs determine the full Moufang polynomial. The sharp bound and equality criterion are correct.
assessments.tau: KdV tau convention, interaction coefficient, phase-shift signs and mass are consistent. This is explicitly identified as a KdV family, not general KP.
assessments.gradients: Scalar saturation and residual singular-value bounds follow with the stated global derivative bound.
assessments.recurrences: Observable-quotient minimal polynomial theorem and scalar-output equality are correct; multi-output counterexample is correctly retained.
assessments.koopman: Degree-growth no-go theorem is valid on an interval and correctly excludes finite-orbit restrictions.
